entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay everyone, this is the first infiltration[n]Fox will be in on from the start—let's do[n]this right!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You seem to be doing well, Inmate.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Our master would like a word with you.[n]Come in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Get with the program, all right? You're[n]a vital member of the team here!
